Coming soon · Music bingo, played live

Live Band Bingo

Bingo with a soundtrack. Every guest gets a bingo card filled with song titles, and the band plays the hits live. Hear a song on your card, mark it off. First to fill a line shouts BINGO and takes the prize. Competitive, hilarious and a great way to get coworkers mixing.

Production

We bring the whole show

We own our sound systems and vehicles, so there's no separate production company to hire.

Sound

Three matching rigs

Identically built systems mean every show sounds the same, even when we're playing more than one event that night.

Engineer

Pro sound tech

A dedicated engineer runs the mix, or teams up with your venue's house engineer.

Two tour trucks and a work van take the band and production wherever your event is. For events too far to drive, we fly.

Get this party started

Every event is quoted individually. Send us these details and we'll confirm your date and follow up with a proposal.

  • Company or client name
  • Event date and times
  • Venue name and city
  • Type of event and approximate guest count
  • The concept you're considering, or the experience you want for your guests
